description: System initialized, key items in storage, waiting for the human to begin
Human opens the kettle lid, signalling intent to make tea (the robot cannot open the lid)
If the water bottle cap is closed and the bottle is in storage, the robot brings the water bottle to the human
With the cap open and the lid open, water is poured into the kettle (robot or human)
After water is poured, the kettle lid is closed and the kettle is switched on; the blue LED turns on
The kettle heats the water until it boils; the blue LED turns off when boiling completes
Robot retrieves the powdered milk container, cup, spoon, tea bag, sugar container and biscuits from storage to the working area
A tea bag is placed into the cup
The boiled water is poured from the kettle into the cup over the tea bag
Human prepares their tea in the cup — adds powdered milk and sugar and stirs
Returns unused items to storage and discards the spent tea bag
